welcome.title: Chidzidzo pamusoro pekunakidzwa kwekuverenga mumitauro yakasiyana.
welcome.phd:
Doktorand: Marta Guidotti, Hasselt University / READSEARCH / tsvakurudzo PXL-MAD / FWO
Mutungamiriri: Prof. Ann Bessemans, Hasselt University / READSEARCH / tsvakurudzo PXL-MAD
Mutungamiriri wechipiri: Prof. Ann Dooms, Vrije Universiteit Brussels
welcome.intro2: Tinokutendai nechido chekupinda muchidzidzo chatiri kuita chinoenderana nechikoro kuti tikwanise kuwana ruzivo pamusoro pe READSEARCH inowanikwa pachikoro che Hasselt ne PXL-MAD School of Arts. Tsvakiridzo iyi irikuitwa nemwana wechikoro chepamusoro chinonzi PHD anonzi Marta Guidotti uyo anoshanda achitariswa na Prof. Ann Bessemans uye na Prof. Ann Dooms.
welcome.summary: Tine mitauro inopfuura mazana mashanu pasi pezuva iyo inoshandisa mavara emu alphabet. Nekuda kwekuti mitauro iyi inoburitsa zvainoreva zvakasiyana nekuti yakaumbwa zvakasiyana tinoona zviri zvakanaka kuti tive tinokubvunzai nechirudzi che Shona. Kuburikidza nekutsvagurudza uku tinoda kuunganidza ruzivo rwekuti kusiyana kwemifananidzo yemutauro kunokanganisa sei ruzivo rwekuverenga maererano nekunyaradza kwemaziso.
welcome.participation: Kana iwe uri muverengi anogona mutauro waamai vako, usina kuremara kwakanyanya kwekuona, uye uri pamusoro pemakore gumi ne nomwe(18), unogona kutora chikamu mukutsvakurudza uku.
welcome.advice: Tinokurudzira kuti uite bvunzo pa kombuta yako, panzvimbo yaunogona kutarisa zviri nyore, uye paunogara zvakajairika. Izvi zvingangove kugara pachigaro chako kana kuti makanyarara uye pasina zvinokanganisa (semuenzaniso mimhanzi, mavhidhiyo, vanhu, nharembozha...).
welcome.ethics: Chirongwa ichi chakaongororwa uye chakabvumidzwa ne Social-Societal Ethics Committee (SMEC) yeHasselt University. Ruzivo rwese ruchagara rusingazivikanwe. Vatori vechikamu vanogona kungoita bvunzo kamwe chete.
welcome.smallText: Mibvunzo yauchapindura ichaburitsa ruzivo runobatsira pakutsvagurudza. Ruzivo urwu ticharushandisa kuongorora chete kuti tsvakurudzo iitwe. Ruzivo rwese urwu kuda kuunganidza nekuda kwezvinangwa zvesainzi sekudzidza mitauro mukati meruzivo rwekuverenga. Nekuenderera mberi nebvunzo, unobvuma wega kutora chikamu uye kubvumirana nekuongororwa uye nemabatirwo achaitwa mhinduro dzichaunganidzwa kubva pamibvunzo. Nekudaro, wakasununguka kuregedza kupindura mubvunzo chero nguva yaunoda. Mumibvunzo, hapana ruzivo rwemunhu chaihwo rwunokumbirwa, rwakadai sezita, uye zera chairo. Kuunganidzwa kwedhata kuri kusingazivikanwe zvachose. Mune mamwe mazwi, hatikukumbiri kuti uendese chero ruzivo rwemunhu chero nguva panguva yechidzidzo.

terms.title: Mitemo nemikana
terms.purposeText: Hwaro hwemutemo hwekugadzirisa ruzivo rwako huri mukufarira nekubatsira veruzhinji. Izvi zvinoreva kuti tsvakiridzo ichatarisira kuwedzera ruzivo uye nzwisiso inobatsira nharaunda (zvakananga kana zvisina kunanga). Muchidzidzo chino tinokumbira ruzivo pamusoro pemakore, mutauro, uye maitiro ekuverenga. Ruzivo urwu rwuchashandiswa chete pakutsvagurudza kwesainzi. Ruzivo urwu rakakosha kuti unzwisise kana paine hukama pakati pemitauro nekunyaradza kwemaziso patinoverenga (kuverengeka) uye kana izvi zvichikanganiswa kana kusiyana maererano nemunhu mumwe nemumwe. Ruzivo rwunotumirwa pamusoro pekubatanidza kwakachengeteka, nokudaro ruzivo rako rinoramba risingazivikanwe zvachose.
terms.requirementsText: Ndinocherechedza kuti ndakaziviswa nezvechinangwa chechidzidzo uye zviri kutarisirwa kubva kwandiri, uye kuti ndakanzwisisa ruzivo rwose urwu. Ndinonzwisisa kuti ndichatora chikamu muchidzidzo ichi ndichizvidira uye kuti ndinogona kumisa kutora chikamu kwangu muchidzidzo chero nguva.
terms.requirementsList1: Ndinonzwisisa kuti ruzivo pamusoro pangu ruchaunganidzwa uye richachengetwa pakachengetedzeka.
terms.requirementsList2: Ndinobvumirana kuti ruzivo rwangu remunhu rwuchagadziriswa.
terms.requirementsList3: Ndinonzwisisa kuti handisi kubhadhara kutora chikamu muchidzidzo ichi.
terms.contactText: Hasselt University inoshanda seye controller mukati mekutsvagurudza uku. Kunyanya, mutsvagurudzi chete ndiye achawana mukana mhinduro yako. Kana uine mibvunzo chaiyo pamusoro pekutsvagurudza uku, kusanganisira kugadziriswa kwemhinduro dzako, uye kushandisa kodzero dzako, ndapota taura naMarta Guidotti (marta.guidotti@uhasselt.be). Kune mimwe mibvunzo pamusoro pekodzero dzako uye zvimwe zvose zvine chokuita nekugadziriswa kwemhinduro dzako semunhu, unogonawo kubata mukuru wedu wekuchengetedza mhinduro chero nguva pa dpo@uhasselt.be. Mukuru uyu anomirira akazvimirira kutevedzera mitemo ine chokuita nekugadziriswa kweruzivo rwemunhu pachikoro chekudzidza kwepamusoro Hasselt University.

task.sliderInstruction: Pazviratidziro zvinotevera uchaona zvidimbu zvezvinyorwa mumitauro yaungaziva kana kuti usingazive. Gadzirisa nzvimbo iri pakati pemitsara, mazwi, uye mavara kuti chinyorwa chive chakanaka kuverenga, kana ukanzwa kuti kugadziriswa uku kwakakosha. Haufanire kunzwisisa zvirimo muchinyorwa.
task.sliderInstruction2: Hakuna mhinduro dzakarurama kana dzisina kururama, saka inzwa wakasununguka kugadzirisa kwaunofunga kuti kunoisa kunyaradza kwekuverenga kuri nani. Unogona kugadzirisa zvakadzama nekukweva mabhara ekutsvedzesa (slider bars).
task.selectInstruction: Iyi mutambo wepamhepo apo iwe uchaona seti dzemavara mana, rimwe nerimwe riri mumutauro wakasiyana. Sarudza uye fananidza zvinyorwa zviviri izvo, pakutanga, zvinoita sezvakafanana.
task.selectInstruction2: Ndapota, edza kupindura kunyange kana zvakaoma kusarudza. Hapana mhinduro dzakarurama.
